recognize_zh: 視野中三顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、呈灰藍色毛玻璃樣，核圓到腎形並有淺摺痕，染色質細緻開放；沒有粗顆粒也沒有 Auer rod。這種灰藍細胞質加上摺疊、細緻染色質的核，是前單核球的樣子，指向急性單核球性白血病。
features: Three large cells with abundant grey-blue, ground-glass cytoplasm
Round to reniform nuclei with shallow folds or a notch
Finely dispersed, delicate chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No coarse azurophilic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells normochromic with a few crenated forms; no mature neutrophils in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three large circulating cells with abundant grey-blue ground-glass cytoplasm and round to reniform, gently folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin. Coarse granules and Auer rods are not seen. These morphologic features correspond to promonocytes, which are counted as blast equivalents. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia; cytochemistry (NSE) and flow cytometry are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes show more condensed, clumped chromatin and more vacuolated cytoplasm, without the delicate immature chromatin.
AMML contains a significant population (≥20%) of neutrophil-lineage cells and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells.
M3v cells show deeply cleft bilobed nuclei and strong MPO positivity with dusty granules.
Hairy cells are smaller with circumferential hair-like projections, oval nuclei and a CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1 B-cell phenotype.
